# SNMP for DuckDB

**Read SNMP devices with SQL.** GET instances, walk subtrees and read MIB tables such as `ifXTable` or `hrStorageTable` as typed rows, over SNMP v1, v2c or v3.

MIB names resolve offline against the bundled IETF and Net-SNMP MIB modules, and table schemas come from the MIB, so `DESCRIBE` works without contacting a device.

Credentials come from a `snmp` DuckDB secret scoped by host, so they stay out of queries.

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Query SNMP agents (routers, switches, servers, printers, UPS units) from SQL. Device queries are table functions that take the agent address first and return either raw variable bindings (one row per OID instance, with the MIB name, SNMP type, display value, exact integer and raw octets) or a MIB conceptual table as typed rows, one column per MIB column, where only the columns the query uses are fetched. Offline helpers translate between MIB names and numeric OIDs and list the objects of the loaded MIBs (IF-MIB, IP-MIB, HOST-RESOURCES-MIB, ENTITY-MIB, ENTITY-SENSOR-MIB, UCD-SNMP-MIB, NET-SNMP-MIB and the SNMPv2 core). SNMP v1, v2c and v3 (USM authentication and privacy) are supported. Credentials come from arguments, a host-scoped DuckDB secret of type `snmp`, or SNMP_* environment variables, so they stay out of queries. To poll several devices, UNION ALL one call per host.
